description: Supervision process fluid specifies information for monitoring the fluid of a pump.

Blockage.description: This attribute indicates a closed valve operation.
Blockage.title: Blockage

Cavitation.description: This attribute indicates cavitation of the pump liquid.
Cavitation.title: Cavitation

Condensation.description: This attribute indicates abnormal condensation in flow medium.
Condensation.title: Condensation

Dry.description: This attribute indicates a dry running.
Dry.title: Dry

Flow.description: This attribute indicates an abnormal flow of the pump fluid.
Flow.title: Flow

Gas.description: This attribute indicates a significant amount of gas in the pump liquid.
Gas.title: Gas

Liquid.description: This attribute indicates a significant amount of liquid in the flow medium.
Liquid.title: Liquid

Pressure.description: This attribute indicates an abnormal pressure of the pump fluid.
Pressure.title: Pressure

ProcessFault.description: This attribute indicates a generic process problem.
ProcessFault.title: ProcessFault

Solid.description: This attribute indicates an significant amount of solid in the pump fluid.
Solid.title: Solid

Stall.description: This attribute indicates a stall of the pump liquid.
Stall.title: Stall

Temperature.description: This attribute indicates an abnormal temperature of the pump fluid.
Temperature.title: Temperature

Viscosity.description: This attribute indicates an abnormal viscosity of the pump liquid.
Viscosity.title: Viscosity
